Name: Phased Array Radar Module

Name: X-Axis Stepper Motor
Description: Stepper motor for precise horizontal (X-axis) positioning of the laser gimbal.

Name: Y-Axis Stepper Motor
Description: Stepper motor for precise vertical (Y-axis) positioning of the laser gimbal.

Name: X-Axis Stepper Driver
Description: Driver module for controlling the X-axis stepper motor, providing microstepping and current control.

Name: Y-Axis Stepper Driver
Description: Driver module for controlling the Y-axis stepper motor, providing microstepping and current control.

Name: High Power Laser Diode
Description: High power (>20W) laser diode for rapid mosquito elimination.

Name: High Power Laser Diode Driver
Description: Current-regulated driver for the high-power laser diode, enabling PWM control.

Name: Voltage Regulator (Buck)
Description: Buck converter to step down battery voltage to 5V for MCU and peripherals.

Name: LiPo Battery Pack
Description: High-capacity Lithium Polymer battery pack for portable power.

Name: Main Chassis Base
Description: Base structure for mounting all components and bottom part of the enclosure.

Description: Mounts to the chassis base and holds the yaw stepper motor.

Name: Gimbal Yaw Arm
Description: Arm extending from the yaw motor, holding the pitch axis assembly.

Name: Gimbal Pitch Mount
Description: Mounts to the yaw arm, holds the pitch stepper motor, laser, and radar module.

Name: Enclosure Top Cover
Description: Top cover for the main chassis, protecting internal components.

Name: M3 Button Head Screw
Description: General purpose screws for mounting components.

Name: M3 Button Head Screw
Description: Longer screws for specific mounting points.

Name: M3 Hex Nut
Description: Used with M3 screws for secure fastening.

Name: M2 Flat Head Screw
Description: Small screws for mounting circuit boards or light components.

Name: M3 Brass Standoff
Description: Standoffs for mounting PCBs securely above the base.

Name: Microcontroller Holder
Description: Holder for the microcontroller (ESP32/RPi Zero 2 W) inside the chassis.

Name: Battery Pack Holder
Description: Holder for the LiPo battery pack inside the chassis.

Name: Main Controller
Description: Microcontroller for radar data processing, gimbal control, and overall system management.

Name: Thermal Camera Module
Description: Infrared thermal sensor array for detecting mosquito heat signatures.

Description: A custom 3D printed bracket to securely attach the thermal camera to the gimbal pitch mount.

Name: AI Processor Module

Name: AI Module Holder
Description: A custom 3D printed bracket to securely mount the AI module to the chassis base.
